incoming_learnings: Budgeted combat recovery can finish long before mandatory discovery becomes actionable. Food availability is not proof of executable health recovery, and selecting preparation at hypothetical full health is not proof of room success. Preserve mandatory pickups, unknown-potion safety and explicit planner exhaustion.

review.review: The hero remained alive at full health when the planner stopped. The initiating contradiction appeared at decision 72 (lines 198–199): the pool chest was observed, but its only admitted hypothetical round trip starts on doorway 1016, which both unknown-potion testing and approach staging reject. Offline reconstruction pinned to the played source matched all 266 recorded actions and reasons; detached arrival and terminal probes reproduced this admission gap. Later intuition attempts failed, leaving three unidentified potions and no identification resource at termination. Decision 266 (lines 736–738) blocked descent for the unfinished chest; mandatory potion discovery also prevented abandonment. No patch is proposed: complete source and reconstructed bookkeeping resolve the observation gaps, but do not establish safe unknown-effect recovery, inventory protection and doorway activation. Merely admitting doors, extending bounds or waiving retrieval would bypass those constraints. The unchanged source passed 2235 unit tests, with four skipped; there is no candidate red/green result.
review.learnings: A hypothetical protected chest route is not executable potion preparation. Validate the joint bank, inventory-protection, actual-effect and return prerequisites before treating pool discovery as actionable. Preserve mandatory pickups and explicit planner exhaustion; unidentified colors remain unknown even after failed intuition guesses.

recommendations.summary: Establish executable identification and protected retrieval when the pool's only admitted trip origin is a doorway.

recommendations.reason: Revalidated in this recording, but not safely repaired. Doorway 1016 admits the seven-step hypothetical chest route while failing both test-bank and staging admission; ordinary exterior origins do not admit that trip. Terminal inventory has no nonconsumptive identification resource. The blocker is an unverified doorway preparation transaction, not missing selecting source or unreconstructed approach counters. Next derive paired arrival/terminal fixtures and validate unknown-effect containment, potion storage and retrieval, fresh arrival, door reclosure, interruption recovery and actual-invisibility-funded return before changing selection. Simply allowing doors, drinking remotely, guessing a color or waiving the chest would bypass unresolved safety constraints. No replacement is certified.
